appraisal_events.evidence: « Allons, aboutonnez voir votre paletot et filons »... je remarquais pour la première fois avec irritation qu'elle avait un langage vulgaire, et hélas, pas de plumet bleu à son chapeau.
appraisal_events.explanation: Recalling the moment beside Gilberte's magical name, the narrator (as remembered child) judges Françoise's speech as vulgar and notes she lacks the elegant marker of the governesses, a mild local discredit by unfavorable comparison.

appraisal_events.evidence: elle me fit demander si je voulais compléter leur camp, et je jouai désormais avec elle chaque fois qu'elle était là.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator, previously only an outside observer of Gilberte's group, is invited to join her game and becomes a recurring participant, a staged local inclusion into her valued circle.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator's newly noticed irritation at Françoise's vulgar speech and plain appearance mildly diminishes her in his esteem, by contrast with the elegant world evoked by Gilberte's name.
Being asked to complete the game and becoming a regular player moves the narrator from excluded onlooker to admitted participant in Gilberte's group.

ambiguities: The narrator's irritation at Françoise's vulgarity could be read either as the unfiltered snobbish judgment of the child, endorsed at the time, or as a moment the retrospective adult narrator recounts with mild self-aware distance; the passage does not make the stance toward this judgment fully explicit.
